description: Add selected passive protections to a DNS-verified target or resume paid monitoring. Existing feature enrollments are retained. Requires owner consent and watch:manage for paid activation, schedule changes and resuming. Before starting or resuming, get approval for 100 file credits per Türkiye calendar day for all covered targets. Resume using the latest billing.pauseRevision from vulkill_watchtower_read. Returns newEnrollments, billing and feature states. A sensor may still need a collector and fresh data. Use vulkill_watchtower_manage with pauseBilling to stop renewal.

consent.description: True only after the account owner explicitly approves the specific change and its effects.

features.description: Add only the owner-selected feature IDs. See the setup view for the required data source for each ID.

minutes.description: Scheduled web check interval: every 15 minutes, daily, or weekly. Omit to keep an existing schedule or use 15 minutes for a new monitor.

priceConsent.description: Send only after the customer explicitly accepts 100 file credits per active account per Türkiye calendar day, covering all selected sites and features, renewing even when the panel is closed.

resumeRevision.description: To resume after a pause, use billing.pauseRevision from the latest overview with a fresh priceConsent.

target.description: Owned, DNS-verified target UUID from vulkill_watchtower_read overview.

name: vulkill_watchtower_enable
